name: Bani
overview: Bani was a male Levite known for his role in teaching and leading the people of Israel during the time of Nehemiah. He explained the law to the people, stood on the Levites' platform, and exhorted Israel to bless the Lord. His name appears on the sealed covenant document, indicating his active participation in the religious reforms of that period.
namesAndTitles: The name Bani is a proper name meaning 'descendant.' There is no indication that this name was given directly by God. The meaning reflects a common Hebrew personal name without additional titles or designations.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Bani as a descendant of Levi, establishing his tribal lineage. Beyond this, no further family relationships are recorded for him in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Bani's significance lies in his leadership among the Levites during the restoration of Israel's worship and law under Nehemiah. By explaining the law and encouraging the people to bless the Lord, he played a vital role in reestablishing covenant faithfulness. His inclusion on the sealed covenant document underscores his commitment to the religious renewal and communal accountability of Israel.
